original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')
from telos import aos_manager

TICK_TO_LOG = 124

aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="storage_list",
    target="shared/agency_lab/",
    metadata={}
)
aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="log_actions",
    target="tick_123",
    metadata={"status": "failed", "reason": "Command not recognized"}
)
